items.title: The NBA strips the Clippers of five first-round picks
items.summary: After a yearlong probe into salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard, the NBA took five first-round picks from the Clippers, fined owner Steve Ballmer $30 million and suspended him for a year.
items.author: @ShamsCharania

post.name: Shams Charania
post.text: BREAKING: The NBA has ruled on the Los Angeles Clippers in for salary cap circumvention investigations on Kawhi Leonard after yearlong probe -- stripping the franchise of 5 first-round picks, issuing a $30 million fine to owner Steve Ballmer and suspensions for Ballmer, Lawrence
